name: Usage normalizes to four disjoint classes
prose: OpenAI-compatible APIs report prompt_tokens as the whole prompt with cached_tokens a subset of it. Getting this wrong double-counts cache and misprices the session, because each class bills at its own rate.
invariant: Input, output, cacheRead and cacheWrite are disjoint and additive, and the OpenAI-compatible adapter subtracts cached_tokens from prompt_tokens.
